slides.title: Arsi: what are church leaders asking for?
What was reported
slides.body: The Ethiopian Orthodox Church's Holy Synod says lives were lost in Merti and Shirka districts of Arsi Zone on Oct 20 and 24, and homes were destroyed. Not independently verified.

slides.title: The Synod's requests
slides.body: Public condemnation by government bodies, stronger protection for civilians, and justice for those responsible. It also plans talks with senior officials.

slides.title: Officials respond
slides.body: Oromia's regional government pledged to pursue those responsible and blamed a rebel alliance. A rebel-linked source blamed the regional government. Neither claim is verified (Reuters).

slides.title: Protect civilians. Independent investigations.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
